		return

import java.util.*;
import java.math.BigInteger;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        if (!sc.hasNextInt()) return;
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        long mod = sc.nextLong();

        if (n == 1) {
            System.out.println(0);
            return;
        }

        long[] z = {1};
        long aaa = 0;

        for (int i = 2; i <= n; i++) {
            long[] nz = new long[i * i / 2 + 1];
            for (int j = 0; j < z.length; j++) {
                if (z[j] > 0) {
                    for (int k = 0; k < i; k++) {
                        nz[i - k - 1 + j] += z[j];
                    }
                }
            }

            long bbb = 0;
            long[] d = new long[z.length + 1];
            for (int w = z.length - 1; w >= 0; w--) {
                d[w] = (d[w + 1] + z[w]) % mod;
            }

            long[] e = new long[d.length + 1];
            long[] f = new long[d.length + 1];
            for (int w = 0; w < d.length; w++) {
                e[w + 1] = (e[w] + d[w]) % mod;
                f[w + 1] = (f[w] - (long) w * d[w]) % mod;
            }

            for (int jj = 0; jj < z.length; jj++) {
                long ccc = 0;
                int L = jj + 2;
                int R = Math.min(z.length - 1, i + jj);
                if (R >= L) {
                    long term1 = (e[R + 1] - e[L]) % mod;
                    long term2 = (f[R + 1] - f[L]) % mod;
                    ccc = (term1 * (i + 1 + jj) + term2) % mod;
                }
                bbb = (bbb + ccc * z[jj]) % mod;
            }

            long perm = nPr(n, n - i, mod);
            aaa = (aaa + (bbb * perm) % mod) % mod;
            z = nz;
        }

        System.out.println((aaa + mod) % mod);
    }

    private static long nPr(int n, int r, long mod) {
        if (r < 0 || r > n) return 0;
        long res = 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < r; i++) {
            res = (res * (n - i)) % mod;
        }
        // The Python code uses factorial(n)//factorial(n-k) where k = n-i
        // This is n! / i!.
        // Let's re-evaluate: A(n, n-i) = n! / (n - (n-i))! = n! / i!
        // This is n * (n-1) * ... * (i+1)
        return nPrCorrected(n, i, mod);
    }
    
    private static long nPrCorrected(int n, int i, long mod) {
        long res = 1;
        for (int k = i + 1; k <= n; k++) {
            res = (res * k) % mod;
        }
        return res;
    }
}
